ask: C11, no dependencies. lines.c: Bresenham line drawing with Cohen-Sutherland clipping to a viewport, midpoint circle and filled circle, an 8-bit framebuffer struct with putpixel bounds checks, and a PGM dump. main draws a clipped test pattern. write the file.
prose:
`lines.c` written. Build and run:

```sh
cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -o lines lines.c -lm
./lines > out.pgm
```

Open `out.pgm` with any image viewer that handles PGM (Preview on macOS, feh/eog on Linux, or convert it with ImageMagick). You should see a dark 640×480 frame with a white viewport border, a fan of clipped gray lines, diagonal grid lines, two circle outlines, and two filled discs.
